ui_aria_attach: Attach a document (PDF, TXT, DOCX, PPTX, ODT, ODP, PNG, JPEG)
mic_error_permission: 🎤 I can't access the microphone. Allow access in your browser settings and try again.
mic_error_unavailable: 🎤 The microphone is not available on this device or browser.
mic_error_network: ⚠️ Transcription failed. Check your connection and try again.
mic_too_short: 🎤 Recording too short — try again and speak a little longer.
mic_empty: 🎤 I couldn't transcribe what you said. Try again, speaking more clearly.
video_url_ask:
This activity needs a video. 🎬

Paste the video URL (Apps Éducation Tubes or PodEduc):
video_url_invalid: Hmm, that doesn't look like a link. Paste a URL starting with https:// (Apps Éducation Tubes or PodEduc).
video_url_detecting: Fetching the video transcript… ⏳ _(up to ~1 min for a long video)_
video_url_failed: I couldn't fetch the transcript for "{label}". Check the link, or paste the transcript manually into the activity field.
bg_image_ask:
This activity needs a background image. 🖼️

Drag it onto this window or attach it with the paperclip 📎.
_Accepted formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, AVIF, SVG, HEIC/HEIF, TIFF — max 12 MB._
bg_image_reminder: I'm waiting for your image 🖼️ — drag it onto this window or attach it with the paperclip 📎 (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, AVIF, SVG, HEIC/HEIF, TIFF — max 12 MB).
bg_image_invalid: ⚠️ **{name}** is not an image that can be used as a background. Accepted formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, AVIF, SVG, HEIC/HEIF, TIFF.
bg_image_too_large: ⚠️ **{name}** exceeds the maximum size for a background image ({max} MB).
bg_image_detecting: Analyzing the image and detecting the key areas… ⏳
bg_image_failed: I couldn't analyze the image for "{label}". You can try again directly in the activity (↻ button).
confirm_missing_qui:
🔎 Before launching, tell me **who you are** (role, subject, grade taught…).
_Example: "Biology teacher in middle school"_
confirm_missing_quoi:
🔎 What's the **specific topic** of your activity?
_Example: "Decimal fractions for 5th graders"_
confirm_missing_niveau:
🎓 For which **level or target audience**? (required to calibrate the content)
_Example: "Year 7", "BTEC Electronics", "adult learners"_
attachment_drop_hint: 📎 Drop a document (PDF, TXT, DOCX, PPTX, ODT, ODP, PNG, JPEG) to transcribe it automatically
attachment_processing: 📎 Transcribing **{name}** in the background… You can keep chatting.
attachment_done: ✅ **{name}** transcribed! The text has been added to the source area.
attachment_unsupported: ⚠️ Unsupported format: **{name}**. Supported: PDF, TXT, DOCX, PPTX, ODT, ODP, PNG, JPEG.
attachment_too_large: ⚠️ **{name}** exceeds the maximum allowed size ({max} MB).
attachment_too_many: ⚠️ **{name}** skipped: a maximum of {max} files can be processed at once. Try again when the current transcriptions are finished.
welcome_message:
Hello! I'm **Caramelia** 🍬
The Caramel assistant. How can I help?
course_opened: The workshop is open. Your fields, sources and draft are preserved. Review the setup and plan in the workshop before starting generation.
course_unavailable: The course workshop is unavailable on this page. Use “A course” in Caramel.
launch_result: {count} file(s) ready out of {total} requested activities. Download them from notifications and check the messages above for any failures.
launch_error: Generation was interrupted. Find completed files in notifications, then retry the missing activities.
help_intro:
Ask me your question about Caramel and I'll help 😊

For example:
- How do I create a quiz?
- What's the difference between H5P and Éléa?
- How do I add a source document?
help_no_response: Sorry, I couldn't get a response.
help_error_offline:
Oops, I can't connect 😓 Here are some tips:

- **Quick mode**: fill in "Who" and "What" then click an activity
- **Advanced mode**: add the level and a source document
- The file downloads automatically
help_error_timeout: ⏱️ The server is taking too long to reply. Please try again in a moment.
help_error_server: 🔧 The server returned an error. Please try again in a few moments.
help_error_empty: 🤐 The server answered, but said nothing. That happens when the model is overloaded — try again, it usually works right away.
gen_qui_prompt:
Great, let's create an activity together! 🎨

**Who are you?**
_Example: "Math teacher in middle school", "Corporate trainer"_
gen_qui_ack_quoi_prompt:
Perfect, **{qui}**!

**What topic** would you like to cover?

_Example: "Fractions", "Photosynthesis"_
gen_quoi_prompt_with_qui:
You are **{qui}**, got it!

**What topic** would you like to cover?

_Example: "The French Revolution", "Angles in 6th grade"_
gen_quoi_ack_category_prompt:
Excellent! Activity on **{quoi}** 📚

What type of activity would suit you?
gen_no_match:
I couldn't find an activity matching "{text}".
Choose from the categories:
checklist_intro: Check the activities to generate then validate:
launch_tile_not_found: ⚠️ Tile **{label}** not found. Moving to next.
launch_done:
✅ The {count} generations have been launched!
Check the **notifications** 🔔 to download your files.
launch_zip_empty: ⚠️ No file ready to bundle yet. Try again once all generations are finished.
extract_fallback_warning: ⚠️ Analyzer connection degraded — I did my best with keywords. Please double-check the summary below.
extract_preselected_intro:
I've pre-selected the most suitable activities 🎯
Adjust if needed, then validate:
enrich_complete_prompt:
Go ahead, refine or enrich the topic ✨
_Current topic: **{quoi}**_
launch_silent_failure: ⚠️ **{label}**: generation finished without producing any file. Try again from the tile, or pick a different activity type.
launch_timeout_failure: ⏱️ **{label}**: generation took too long, I forced the sidebar to close. Retry or pick another activity type.
proactive_suggest_intro: 💡 To go further on **{quoi}**, I can also prepare:
proactive_suggest_ok: No problem, see you soon for another activity! 😊
attach_subject_confirm: 📄 I've read **{name}**: it seems to be about **{quoi}**. Is that the topic of your activity?
attach_subject_ask: Alright! What exact **topic** do you want to work on? ✨
attach_subject_unknown: 📄 I received **{name}**, but I can't pin down its topic. Want to create an activity? Tell me the subject.
